title: Crystal Orca in Ruins
description: A large orca composed of glossy black and white crystalline shards swims underwater through a submerged futuristic ruin. Beams of light pierce the dark blue water from above, illuminating the fractured geometric form of the whale and scattered broken architectural fragments around it.
prompt: A majestic orca whale made entirely of sharp black and white crystalline geometric facets swimming through dark underwater ruins, dramatic shafts of light beaming down from the surface, broken futuristic architectural fragments floating in the water, ethereal atmosphere, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting
